mentions.name: AI Workspace for Neovim
mentions.description: An AI workspace that runs inside Neovim, using the editor as its TUI. Built as a learning project to understand how modern AI agent tools like Claude Code work under the hood, covering AI systems, agent loops, prompt engineering, and what makes a good, usable AI agent.
